class: A job posting's job-alert subscription widget and 'Apply Now <Job Title>' control caused the agent to subscribe to job alerts instead of clicking Apply
symptom: On Pacific Life's Sr Network Engineer posting (Phenom People), the agent skipped the orange 'Apply Now' button, typed the applicant's email into the 'Get notified for similar jobs' ('Sign up to receive job alerts') sidebar widget, and clicked its 'Submit' button -- triggering 'Success! Successfully subscribed for similar jobs' and stopping at review handoff.
root_cause: Four interacting defects: (1) browser_automation.is_review_step() matched any visible button with text 'Submit', including the job-alert widget's Submit button, which made on_job_description() return False so apply_flow never clicked Apply before handing the page to PageAgent; (2) page_agent.parse_snapshot() parsed the Email address input and Submit button inside 'Get notified for similar jobs' and other jobs' Apply links under 'Similar jobs' as controls of this application; (3) page_agent.profile_forward() and profile_plan() required exact 'Apply' / 'Apply now' on control.name and did not recognise WCAG-labelled 'Apply Now <Job Title>' links/buttons, choosing the job-alert 'Submit' button instead; (4) posting_entry.py rejected 'Apply Now <Job Title>' aria-labels and treated the job-alert email input as an application form on the page.
why_tests_missed: Existing posting tests used bare 'Apply' / 'Apply now' labels and search boxes inside <header>/<input type=search>, never a Phenom/TalentBrew/Jibe posting with 'Apply Now <Job Title>' and a 'Get notified for similar jobs' ('Sign up to receive job alerts') region carrying its own Email input and 'Submit' button.
fix: Ignore job-alert / talent-community signup widgets and 'Similar jobs' sections in parse_snapshot(), browser_automation (is_review_step, find_apply_control, find_submit_button), and posting_entry.py; recognise 'Apply Now <Job Title>' / 'Apply for <Job Title>' controls as opening the application across profile_forward(), profile_plan(), _press_next_locked(), and posting_entry.py.
prevention: Job posting pages frequently embed non-application widgets (job-alert subscriptions, talent-community signups, similar-job carousels) that contain email inputs, 'Submit' buttons, and other jobs' 'Apply Now' links. Always exclude non-application regions/sections before classifying a page as an application form or review step, and accept WCAG-compliant 'Apply Now <Job Title>' accessible names.
